dynamic_timing_and_refresh_scope.scope: Conservative action-to-capture upper bound, not precise enable-edge latency; both samples are earlier than original P20 seconds
dynamic_timing_and_refresh_scope.interpretation: Active dynamic-preset completion was observed; separate panel and table samples do not establish simultaneous V/Q, clamping or next-tick precision.

settled_outcomes: Retentive TON V4/P20 held with IN false, resumed to V20/Q0 on; disabling after completion cleared V0.
Retentive TOF V11/P20 held with IN true, resumed to V20/Q1 off; rearming I1 true gave V0/Q1 on.
Dynamic TON table changed from V1/P20 to V5/P5; a separate panel showed Q2 and Q10 on. Later disable cleared V0/P5 and restore returned V0/P20.
runtime.duplicate_image_note: Repeated held-value captures can have identical PNG bytes; they are separately timestamped observations, not claimed unique controller scans.

visible_environment_status.scope: Visible existing lab environment status. This read-only report did not alter validation or integrity checks; no physical-controller equivalence is asserted.

literal_oracle.timing_convention: dt_ms advances time after the current scan in native and VM APIs; it is not official GUI timing.

prior_paired_controls.scope: Earlier hand-built diagnostic and flags-off controls are separate. No generated-product flags-off control runtime is claimed here.

limits: Only three separate modes at base 1000 ms / actual Man21; no other base, level, kind or combined-mode admission is inferred.
The five-second GUI refresh and separate captures prevent fine timing, same-scan, V-clamping or next-tick conclusions.
No physical PLC, controller firmware or output-load proof.
Only official simulator buttons were used; no forced memory or external TCP client.
No full regression suite was run for this GUI stage.
The RUN capture retains the Untrusted DLL detected lab banner; no integrity-check bypass or physical-controller equivalence is claimed.
